Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzdeWQgfuLGkDUqrKv

* fix(admin/products): Reactivate only when Sold Out was forced; explain an automatic sold-out

The row offered 'Reactivate (Auto)' for every sold-out product. On an
automatic sold-out (no stock + a sell limit, or supplier unavailable)
manual_status is already null, so the button did nothing (2.5g Nadir).
Now productStatusAction() picks: Mark Sold Out / Reactivate (only when the
admin forced it) / a self-explanatory note with no button.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzdeWQgfuLGkDUqrKv

* fix(shop): a Premium Curve bar of ANY size shows Qty + Add, not only the anchor sizes

The shop's row view and the admin '+X%' pill looked a curve size up EXACTLY in
the premiums table (anchors 1g/5g/10g/1oz/50g/100g). A size between anchors -
2.5g today, a 1/2 oz or 2g/20g tomorrow, even a 1 oz stored as 31.1 instead of
31.1035 - had no row, so the shop row hid Qty + Add while the kernel still
priced it, and admin read '+0%'. Both now read the interpolated rate the cart
charges (getPremiumForWeight): the row from priceShopCatalog's premiumPct, the
pill via the new curvePremiumPctForGrams(). Tile view, product page and iOS
already priced through the kernel.

Tests: curve-off-anchor-size (2.5g, 1/2 oz, 1 oz as 31.1035/31.1/31.10348,
2g, 20g, below/above the anchor range) + curve-off-anchor-row (the row renders
Add for 2.5g, 1/2 oz, 1 oz).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzdeWQgfuLGkDUqrKv

* feat(shop): first paint has live prices; a loading price never hides a product's Qty + Add

- /shop fetches the pricing snapshot (spot, FX, premiums) in its existing
  server batch and seeds it with <PricingSeed> above <ShopClient> (seed-only,
  never clobbers a fresher client tick, still seeds unpersisted premiums).
  The layout's streamed <PricingBootstrap> could land after the shop rendered
  on a cold load, which is when rows showed Loading and no Add.
- composePricingSnapshotWithin(): the 900 ms capped read, shared by the
  layout and /shop (one cap, one place).
- Curve row: while premiums load, Qty + Add stay on screen, Add disabled,
  price 'Loading…' (was: controls hidden). No 'Enquire' for curve: any size
  is priceable once premiums load.
- Tile: 'Enquire' only for a standard bar with no tiers; otherwise
  'Loading…' (was 'Enquire' on every cold load).

Tests: pricing-seed (seed / fresher-spot / no-op / wiring), pricing-snapshot
(capped read: in time, slower than cap -> null, error -> null),
curve-off-anchor-row (loading keeps controls, disabled).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzdeWQgfuLGkDUqrKv

* feat(consignment): an indexed term's fallback is the latest CHARGED premium

Mukesh, 2026-11-06: when no StoneX price is available, use the latest
charged. The fallback (supplier_product_terms.premium_sgd on a stonex_indexed
term) was a number typed once; StoneX stopped listing the 20g PAMP Fortuna
after 3 Nov, so a sale would have charged the S$59.00 fallback while the last
premium actually charged was S$63.99.

rememberChargedIndexedPremium() writes a live charge back as the fallback on
every open indexed term of the same supplier + reference line (two listings of
one bar share a line). recordConsignmentProcurement calls it after a sale is
recorded at a live (non-fallback) premium; a fallback charge is never written
back over itself. Best-effort: a failed write is logged, never fails the sale.

PROD data (same day, by SQL): fallbacks set to the latest charged premium -
1g Nadir 14.03 (PO-0069), 2.5g PAMP 38.63, 10g PAMP 46.75 (both listings) and
20g PAMP 63.99 (PO-0072), 5g PAMP 45.00 (PO-0067).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzdeWQgfuLGkDUqrKv

* feat(admin/serials): Attach batch — the app attaches a serial-photo inbox batch itself

Mukesh, 2026-11-06: automate the batch attach, so a batch never needs the
production storage key outside the app (today's serial-20261106-1732 had to
wait for one).

Admin → Serials → photo inbox → Attach batch (POST
/api/admin/serials/photo-inbox/attach): for each photo, the new
serial_photo_reader agent (vision, fast tier) reads the certificate /
engraved / NFC-card number; decidePhoto() (lib/nfc/photo-batch-match.ts)
attaches only on exactly one live, unphotographed card with no card/bar
contradiction and confidence >= 0.8. The original bytes (JPEG/PNG/WEBP) are
uploaded under product-media/nfc-serials/<serial>/, sha256-verified, pointed
at by nfc_serials.image_url, and only then removed from the inbox. Anything
unclear stays in the inbox with its reason in the report. HEIC/GIF are
converted to WebP so a browser can show them.

Migration 20261106_serial_photo_reader_agent registers the agent + its
capability card (rows only, no table; applied on DEV).
Tests: serial-photo-batch-match (matcher + reply parse), and
serials-photo-inbox-attach-route (as-is attach, skip stays, failed verify
blocks, no overwrite). docs/architecture.html route count 596 -> 597.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzdeWQgfuLGkDUqrKv

* fix(admin/serials): Attach batch — audit trail, no orphaned uploads, one batch-name normaliser

Security-agent review on #728 (972039b):
- MEDIUM (no human step between the AI read and the write): inbox writes are
  admin-only, so the realistic risk is a misread, already contained by the
  strict matcher + never-overwrite. Added the suggested traceability: every
  attach (decision_executed) and every skip (guardrail_triggered) is written to
  the append-only agent_events with the reading, the value matched and the
  card, so a wrong attach is traceable and reversible. No two-step confirm:
  the point of the button is not needing one (Mukesh); the report shows each
  mapping.
- LOW (orphaned public object on a failed verify): an upload that fails
  verification or loses the card race is now removed.
- INFO (upper-case batch name 400s): both inbox routes use one normaliser,
  lib/nfc/inbox-batch.ts (moved out of upload-url), so a typed name attaches
  under the folder it was uploaded to.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019USENzdeWQgfuLGkDUqrKv

* feat(dispatch): Move to Grab Express — a manual courier with tracking link + cost

A Lalamove order not yet with a Lalamove driver can move to Grab Express,
booked by hand in the Grab app. Admin then pastes the Grab share link (the
customer's Track button; https grab.com only) and the trip cost, and marks it
delivered (order completed, bars sold). The cost is required before delivery
so every Grab trip lands in shipper_actual_fee_sgd; a failed Lalamove quote is
cleared on the move so it never counts as the Grab cost.

- lib/shipping/grab-manual.ts: pure rules shared by route + Dispatch screen
- POST /api/admin/orders/[id]/grab: move / track / deliver, guarded on the
  shipper read, audit event appended, receipt cache invalidated on move
- Dispatch: "Move to Grab Express" on Lalamove awaiting-booking tiles; Grab
  Express sections (add link / on the way) with Shipping label + Mark Delivered
- shipperLabel('grab') → "Grab Express"; the shipping label names the carrier
  even with no tracking number
